lead_raw_text:
The structure of Er8Ag4Pt4 (Er2AgPt) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis shows each Ag and Pt center surrounded by eight Er neighbors, and each Er center by four Ag plus four Pt neighbors, all with a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement and a uniform neighbor distance of 2.9271 Å. The periodic geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connects all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Er–Er 8-vertex polyhedra sharing corner, edge, and face contacts, while Ag–Pt polyhedra share corners and faces.
